text:
maya (Product): Customer asks for APAC staged rollout + BYOK + per-tenant opt-in. Needs A/B against hosted baseline and a kill-switch. Pilot in 5 weeks.

raj (Eng): Quick take: hosted BYOK needs envelope support + audit hashes. Routing per-region can be header-driven.

toni (SRE): We should shadow traffic first: 24h @0.1% -> 5% opt-in -> 25% A/B. Mirror throttle and synthetic canaries required. Auto-fail to global-hosted on p95 breach.

leo (Solutions): Customer wants downloadable daily A/B report and an ops-runbook with CLI opt-in.

sam (Legal): Confirm deletion proof in contract; we can provide revocation events + attest re-encryption steps. Don't log plaintext keys.

raj (Eng): Estimate: envelope BYOK + audit hash (2w), mirror throttles + failover (2w), opt-in UI + runbook (1w). Parallel reduces overall.

maya (Product): Decision: try hosted-BYOK gated by those features; fall back to Dedicated if timeline slips. Action items: @raj BYOK, @toni throttles+canaries, @leo runbook, @sam contract clause. Reconvene in 3 days. :thumbsup:
